description: Implementation of Manufacturer Data Access Object (DAO) for database operations related to Manufacturer entities, including listing manufacturers by store, retrieving by ID, counting attached products, and listing by product categories.

classes.name: ManufacturerDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Manufacturer entity, providing methods for querying manufacturer data from the database.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a specific manufacturer.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with a specific store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Manufacturer entity by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all manufacturers associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers linked to products within specified category IDs and store, filtered by language.
